title: Piercing Frame Duo #020 (얼굴 컷 · [일반·P25 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 웨이쉰] ; [일반·P25 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 웨이쉰])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women side by side, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the base of their necks and the tops of their collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Every face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge yellow-gold bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide yellow-gold ear cuff, three smaller yellow-gold rings, two thick yellow-gold bars and a small yellow-gold stud up to the top; one small yellow-gold stud sits in the right ear; four yellow-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small yellow-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick yellow-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a yellow-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a yellow-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small yellow-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a yellow-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a yellow-gold labret stud and a small yellow-gold ring sit on the chin; three small yellow-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small sapphires set into the metal.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, deep dark brown hair styled in a short pixie cut. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge rose-gold drop dangle hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, three smaller rose-gold rings, two thick rose-gold bars and a small rose-gold stud up to the top; one small rose-gold stud sits in the right ear; four rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small rose-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick rose-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a rose-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a rose-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small rose-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a rose-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a rose-gold labret stud and a small rose-gold ring sit on the chin; three small rose-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
